#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# heartbeat.sh — periodically call a monitoring endpoint.
#
# Usage:
#   ./heartbeat.sh -u https://example.com/heartbeat
#   ./heartbeat.sh -u https://example.com/heartbeat -i 60
#   ./heartbeat.sh -u https://example.com/heartbeat -i 60 -t 8 --method POST
#   MONITOR_URL=... MONITOR_INTERVAL=60 ./heartbeat.sh
#
# Notes:
# - Exits non-zero if curl is missing.
# - Retries transient failures with exponential backoff.
# - Runs until interrupted (Ctrl+C) unless --once is used.

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
heartbeat.sh — periodically call a monitoring endpoint.

Options:
  -u, --url URL         Monitoring endpoint URL (or env MONITOR_URL)
  -i, --interval SEC    Seconds between calls (default: 60; or env MONITOR_INTERVAL)
  -t, --timeout SEC     Per-request timeout seconds (default: 10; or env MONITOR_TIMEOUT)
  -m, --method METHOD   HTTP method (default: GET)
  -H, --header HEADER   Extra header (repeatable)
  -d, --data DATA       Request body (implies POST if method not set)
      --insecure        Allow insecure TLS (curl -k)
      --once            Send one heartbeat and exit
      --no-retry        Disable retries
  -h, --help            Show this help

Examples:
  ./heartbeat.sh -u https://hc-ping.com/<uuid>
  ./heartbeat.sh -u https://example.com/health -i 30 -m POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'
EOF
}

need_cmd() {
  command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Missing required command: $1" >&2; exit 127; }
}

URL="${MONITOR_URL:-}"
INTERVAL="${MONITOR_INTERVAL:-60}"
TIMEOUT="${MONITOR_TIMEOUT:-10}"
METHOD="${MONITOR_METHOD:-}"
DATA="${MONITOR_DATA:-}"
INSECURE=0
ONCE=0
NO_RETRY=0
HEADERS=()

# Parse args
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    -u|--url) URL="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    -i|--interval) INTERVAL="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    -t|--timeout) TIMEOUT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    -m|--method) METHOD="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    -H|--header) HEADERS+=("$2"); shift 2 ;;
    -d|--data) DATA="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --insecure) INSECURE=1; shift ;;
    --once) ONCE=1; shift ;;
    --no-retry) NO_RETRY=1; shift ;;
    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    *) echo "Unknown option: $1" >&2; usage; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

if [[ -z "$URL" ]]; then
  echo "Error: --url is required (or set MONITOR_URL)" >&2
  usage
  exit 2
fi

if [[ -z "$METHOD" ]]; then
  if [[ -n "$DATA" ]]; then
    METHOD="POST"
  else
    METHOD="GET"
  fi
fi

# Basic validation
if ! [[ "$INTERVAL" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || [[ "$INTERVAL" -lt 1 ]]; then
  echo "Error: interval must be a positive integer (seconds)" >&2
  exit 2
fi
if ! [[ "$TIMEOUT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || [[ "$TIMEOUT" -lt 1 ]]; then
  echo "Error: timeout must be a positive integer (seconds)" >&2
  exit 2
fi

need_cmd curl

curl_args=(
  --silent --show-error --fail
  --request "$METHOD"
  --max-time "$TIMEOUT"
  --connect-timeout "$TIMEOUT"
  --location
)

if [[ $INSECURE -eq 1 ]]; then
  curl_args+=(--insecure)
fi

for h in "${HEADERS[@]}"; do
  curl_args+=(--header "$h")
done

if [[ -n "$DATA" ]]; then
  curl_args+=(--data "$DATA")
fi

# On termination, exit cleanly
trap 'echo "Stopping heartbeat loop" >&2; exit 0' INT TERM

send_once() {
  local attempt=0
  local backoff=1
  local max_backoff=60

  while :; do
    attempt=$((attempt + 1))

    if curl "${curl_args[@]}" "$URL" >/dev/null; then
      return 0
    fi

    if [[ $NO_RETRY -eq 1 ]]; then
      echo "Heartbeat failed (no-retry enabled)" >&2
      return 1
    fi

    # retry with exponential backoff
    echo "Heartbeat failed (attempt ${attempt}); retrying in ${backoff}s" >&2
    sleep "$backoff"
    backoff=$((backoff * 2))
    if [[ $backoff -gt $max_backoff ]]; then
      backoff=$max_backoff
    fi
  done
}

if [[ $ONCE -eq 1 ]]; then
  send_once
  exit $?
fi

while :; do
  send_once || true
  sleep "$INTERVAL"
done
